change.item: Day, hour, minute and second labels come from the plugin's language files (English and Malay), so other languages can be added with Joomla's Language Overrides.

addition.item: First release: count down to a date and time in the site's time zone, to a time every day, or an evergreen countdown that starts on each visitor's first visit (and can start again). Plain, boxes, progress circles or flip cards, a choice of units, labels in Malay or English, and when time is up hide the countdown, show a message or go to a page.
